title: Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Exposure of File…
description: Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition versions prior to 5.36.00.16 have a file descriptor leak vulnerability. This flaw allows a low privileged local attacker to expose sensitive information by accessing file descriptors outside their intended control sphere. The vulnerability has a medium severity with a CVSS score of 5.5.
